from: Mark the test Blocked with the exact query you typed and what came back, and flag it - a task ticket goes to the Product Owner to confirm whether the loss is acceptable. Do not raise it as a defect until the PO has ruled, and do not pass the test just because the V2 specification allows the new behaviour.
to: Mark the test FAILED and write down the exact words you typed and what came back. It worked in the previous version, so it has to work here - failing is a fault and a ticket is raised against it. Do not pass the test just because the newer specification allows the new behaviour.
